about: Card Y1 acceptance fixtures — subject / continuation / mutation are three decisions. Each case is a stream of observations carrying an explicit SUBJECT key (the Y5/Z3 judge-emitted key, stubbed here) against a per-concern EpisodePolicy. `expect.episodes` is the distinct-episode count; `expect.reasons` is the typed percept.episodes.CONTINUATION_REASONS trace, one per observation, in order.

cases.name: inside_gap_continues
cases.why: Same subject, still open, inside the concern's continuity gap -> ONE episode.

cases.name: after_gap_opens_new
cases.why: Same SUBJECT is not the same EPISODE: the invoice returns after the continuity window as a new workflow occurrence.

cases.name: aba_no_spurious_third
cases.why: A, then B, then A again inside A's gap. The revisit continues A — it must not mint a third episode.

cases.name: terminal_reopen_disallowed
cases.why: A PO opened, closed and seen again. With allow_reopen=false that is a second occurrence, not a mutated first one.

cases.name: terminal_reopen_allowed
cases.why: A conversational claim slot revisited within the same call: the concern's policy says a reopen is the SAME episode.
